criteria.expectedOutcome: Provide the full drag-and-drop ship/pier/line canvas, ingest mock wind/current, iteratively evaluate line geometry and bollard strain against applicable NSTM 582 limits, recommend optimal tug horsepower and line sequences, and warn at approved gust breaking thresholds.
criteria.reason: Authoritative equations, NSTM revision, capacities, thresholds and optimization objective are absent. Planned synthetic intake/layout is only a demonstrated slice.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Every calculation and below/at/above-limit boundary matches independently worked SME-signed synthetic reference cases within approved tolerances.
criteria.reason: No authoritative equations, signed cases or approved tolerances supplied. Toolkit fixtures cannot verify application engineering.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Reject missing inputs, inconsistent units, out-of-range values and unsupported craft configurations, with approved unit conversions and physical boundaries.
criteria.reason: Approved conversion rules, physical ranges and craft definitions are absent. Planned completeness and structural unit/configuration checks cannot satisfy the whole criterion.

criteria.expectedOutcome: The self-contained offline review screen shows missing engineering authority and unknown uncertainty, requires explicit acknowledgement of a saved synthetic scenario revision, blocks review of unsaved edits, invalidates acknowledgement on changed saved content and never grants operational approval. Qualified human authority is preserved by keeping engineering decisions unavailable.
Output an approved Mooring Evolution Safety Sheet and graphical layout with traceable agent rationale and validated safety margins, plus demo walkthrough and one-page fielding brief.
criteria.reason: Approved sheet schema, approval process and engineering basis are absent. The planned marked synthetic summary/layout, walkthrough and brief demonstrate only a limited slice.
